_source.IN: Nationally observed holidays: the 17 compulsory gazetted holidays for Central Government offices (DoPT O.M. F.No.12/2/2023-JCA dated 03.07.2025 for 2026, https://dopt.gov.in/sites/default/files/Holidays%20to%20be%20observed%20in%20Central%20Government%20Offices%20during%20the%20year%202026.pdf ; dated 16.07.2026 for 2027, https://dopt.gov.in/sites/default/files/Holiday%20list%202027.PDF , table as published at https://www.staffnews.in/2026/07/list-of-holidays-for-the-year-2027-gazetted.html). RBI notifies bank holidays state by state under the Negotiable Instruments Act (https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/HolidayMatrixDisplay.aspx), so there is no single all-India RBI list; the DoPT gazetted list is used as the national proxy. Weekend dates are kept as published (they change nothing). Moon-dependent dates (Id, Muharram, Milad-un-Nabi) can shift by a day.
_source.US: Federal Reserve System holidays, Board K.8 (https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm) and https://www.chicagofed.org/utilities/about-us/federal-reserve-calendars . Rule: a holiday on Saturday does not close Reserve Banks on the Friday before; a holiday on Sunday closes them the following Monday (so 2027-07-05 is listed for July 4, 2027). Saturday dates are kept as published.
